title: Ren and the Basket of Buns
youtube_title: Ren and the Basket of Buns | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can mean helping someone's leftover food find the people who will enjoy it.
summary: Ren sees Mrs. Pell with buns still unsold as the lantern walk begins. He helps pack them into a basket and offers them gently to walkers so the warm bread is shared.
